chunks: Ibn Bukayr narrated from Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
If a man has a slave and frees him, knowing that he has wealth, and the master did not exclude the wealth at the time he freed him, then it belongs to the slave.

key_terms.فَأَعْتَقَهُ: so he emancipated him and granted him freedom
key_terms.مَالًا: property or wealth possessed by the slave

ai.seo_question: When a master emancipates a slave who has property, does that wealth belong to the master or to the slave?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the property of a slave at the time of emancipation. If the master frees the slave while knowing that the slave possesses wealth, and he does not explicitly exclude that wealth, then the wealth remains for the freed slave.
